_about: Song 75, Farmacia del Puerto, Don Héctor. One set-up (the counter, the doorway to the consultorio on one side), every picture an edit of greet. Twists: store_brand (outbrand, at switch_q), see_doctor / consultorio (doctor, at doctor_q), rx_prompt (rxask). The store_brand line itself is said in the dosage turn, so outbrand shows at the question that follows it.

items.prompt: Don Héctor, the pharmacist, stands behind the white and teal counter about one third from the left, both hands resting on the counter, and greets the learner with a calm, reassuring smile, asking what they need. The shelves of medicine boxes behind him, the small jar of lollipops and the card terminal with a blank screen on the counter; the open doorway to the doctor's office on one side.
Change only his pose: Don Héctor recognizes the learner, a warm smile of recognition, and holds one open hand out over the counter, palm up, ready to take a prescription.
Change only his pose: Don Héctor leans slightly forward over the counter, his forearms on it, his head tilted, listening closely with a kind, concerned look as he asks questions about the symptoms.
Change only his pose: Don Héctor holds up a small white medicine box with a simple teal stripe and no writing toward the learner in one hand, recommending it, a confident, reassuring smile.

Change only his pose: Don Héctor holds up two medicine boxes side by side, one in each hand: a glossy box with a bold orange stripe (the brand-name one) and a plain white box with a thin gray stripe (the generic), both without writing, eyebrows raised, asking which one.

Change only his pose: Don Héctor stands half turned toward the shelves, pointing with one hand at an empty gap on the shelf behind him, and holds up a plain white box with a thin gray stripe and no writing in the other hand, an apologetic smile (the brand-name one is out; the generic is the same).

Change only his pose: Don Héctor holds up a silver blister pack of white tablets in one hand and points at one tablet with the index finger of his other hand, explaining how to take it, a patient, attentive look over his glasses.
Change only his pose: Don Héctor gestures with an open hand toward the open doorway to the small doctor's office next door, a caring, serious look, suggesting the learner see the doctor.

Change only his pose: Don Héctor holds a paper prescription in both hands at chest height, a blank sheet with only a few gray scribbled lines and no readable writing, and reads it through his glasses, focused.
Change only his pose: Don Héctor holds the card terminal out toward the learner over the counter, its screen blank, a small white medicine box on the counter in front of him, a polite smile.
Change only his pose: Don Héctor holds out a small white paper bag, folded over at the top, toward the learner across the counter, a kind smile.
